text:
sara: quick sync — I'm drafting a rollout pattern for the new traffic-shaping feature. goal: reduce blast radius, measure quality delta, and keep customer-impact low. proposal below, need eng/sre + solutions signoff.

liam: can you call out the hard SLOs we need (p50/p95 latency, error-rate) and the guardrail metrics for auto-rollback?

noah: +1 on SLOs. suggest these initial thresholds: p95 < 400ms, error-rate < 0.5% (5xx/timeout), queue-depth jitter < 2x baseline. add a circuit-backer that flips traffic to legacy route on sustained breach for 10m.

maya: for A/B we'd want a quick quality eval (3k samples) in phase 1 to surface hallucination/regression. also confirm if tenant-level opt-out is required for enterprise customers.

evan: yes, sales asked for explicit per-tenant disable. we should ensure the flag system supports tenant exemptions + opt-in cohorts. also want an SLA-friendly holdback for top 10 customers.

noah: rough config mock (for ops/runbook):
```yaml
flag: traffic_shaper_v1
phases:
  - name: smoke
    pct: 1
    regions: [us-west-2]
    duration: 2h
    checks:
      - p95_latency_ms: 400
      - error_rate_pct: 0.5
  - name: regional-bake
    pct: 10
    regions: [us-west-2, eu-west-1]
    duration: 12h
  - name: global-roll
    pct: 50
    regions: all
    duration: 48h
kill_switch: true
fallback_policy: route_to: redwood-small_variant
alert_window: 10m
```

liam: that looks good. add a step to shadow traffic for 24h before smoke to compare RT distribution without affecting stability. shadowing helps quantify ops cost delta.

sara: decision items: (1) final SLO numbers (noah to confirm), (2) per-tenant opt-out API contract (evan + eng), (3) runbook kill-switch playbook and owners (noah + liam). I'll schedule a 30m shiproom Wed 10am.

deploy-bot: deploy plan created: traffic_shaper_v1 | draft | owner:@sara | scheduled: wed-10:00 — remember to run preflight checks. :robot_face:

maya: quick ask — can we capture evaluation metrics into the console as a new 'rollout-quality' dashboard? that'll speed gating decisions.

sara: yes, product will own dashboard spec. evan — loop in customer success for top-10 holdback coordination. we'll treat launch as gated until dashboard + opt-out API are done.

liam: will add canary rollback playbook to the PR and link to runbook.

noah: noted. I'll draft the circuit thresholds + alerting runbook and ping the thread when ready.

sara: perfect — thanks everyone. if no objections by EOD Tue we'll move to schedule. :thumbsup:
